results.statement: When runner.python names a venv, sc-lint must prepend that venv's bin directory (Scripts on Windows) to the PATH of every step's child process.
results.quote:
(2) the venv's bin/Scripts dir is prepended to the child's PATH (our `python_cmd` does this today so helpers that spawn `python` stay pinned)
[…]
(plus the PATH prepend in (2) applied to every step)
results.context: Issue acceptance text: https://github.com/randlee/sc-lint/issues/198#issuecomment-6513016954 (a)(2) + mismatch paragraph (re-registered from GH-198.runner-path.2, ID-only change)
results.deterministic_check: A step-environment test with injected platform shows PATH starts with the venv bin or Scripts directory for a python step and a native step.
